record.name: Hızlı Kargo
record.description: Gönderilerinizi takip edin, kargo oluşturun, şube bulun.

label: official
rationale: Rule 1. Official publisher and package id. Note RECEIVE_SMS is legitimate in logistics (delivery codes).

record.name: Hızlı Kargo Kurye
record.description: Kuryeler için teslimat ve rota uygulaması. Personel girişi gerektirir.

label: official
rationale: Rule 1. Internal staff app with aggressive permissions and low rating; nothing here should count against an official publisher.

record.name: HK Esnaf
record.description: Küçük işletmeler için toplu gönderi ve fatura yönetimi.

label: official
rationale: Rule 1. Ecosystem app using an abbreviation (HK) that no name-based query would match. Publisher veto is the only path to the correct label; discovery may miss it entirely, which is itself a finding.

label: official
rationale: Rule 1 after normalization. Publisher name is the official one with Turkish characters flattened by the store. Exact string match fails; normalized match must succeed. Website confirms.

record.name: Kargom Nerede: Tüm Kargolar
record.description: Hızlı Kargo, Aras, Yurtiçi, MNG ve 15+ kargo firmasını tek uygulamadan takip edin. Takip numaranızı girin, bildirim alın.

label: third_party_legitimate
rationale: Rule 4. Multi-carrier tracker; brand is one of many in the description, name has no brand overlap. Reads SMS for tracking codes, which a bank-tuned permission rule would flag. Established publisher, large organic base.

record.name: Hızlı Kargo Entegrasyon - Mağaza Paneli
record.description: E-ticaret siteniz için Hızlı Kargo API entegrasyonu. Barkod oluşturma ve toplu gönderi. Hızlı Kargo müşteri numarası gerektirir.

label: third_party_legitimate
rationale: Rule 4. Name starts with the brand and package id contains it, which is the impersonation shape. Description positions it as an integration tool for merchants, not the consumer app. Boundary case between rule 3 and rule 4; decided by absence of any claim to be the brand's own app.

record.name: Hızlı Kargo Takip
record.description: Hızlı Kargo gönderilerinizi takip edin. Hızlı, kolay, ücretsiz.

label: uncertain
rationale: Rule 6. Single-app young publisher and READ_CONTACTS lean towards impersonation; description does not claim to be the official app and trackers are a common legitimate category. Without the official permission set, drift cannot be computed. High rating with low review count is consistent with both purchased reviews and a small honest app.

record.name: Hızlı Not
record.description: Tek dokunuşla not alın. Reklamsız, çevrimdışı.

label: unrelated
rationale: Rule 5. 'Hızlı' is an everyday adjective. Matches only because the query expander will search the first token.

record.name: Kargo Ücreti Hesapla
record.description: Desi hesaplama ve kargo ücreti tahmini. Tüm firmalar.

label: unrelated
rationale: Rule 5. Same sector, no reference to the brand. Matched by the second token only.
